# Motor Inn of Carroll - AI-Readable Resources

Canonical website: https://www.motorinnofcarroll.com  
AI-readable discovery host: https://ai.motorinnofcarroll.com

- [Dealership overview](https://ai.motorinnofcarroll.com/dealership.md)
- [Contact and hours](https://ai.motorinnofcarroll.com/contact-hours.md)
- [Service](https://ai.motorinnofcarroll.com/service.md)
- [Finance and trade](https://ai.motorinnofcarroll.com/finance-trade.md)
- [Policies](https://ai.motorinnofcarroll.com/policies.md)
- [Current new Chevrolet inventory](https://ai.motorinnofcarroll.com/new-inventory.md)
- [Current pre-owned inventory](https://ai.motorinnofcarroll.com/used-inventory.md)
- [Current offers](https://ai.motorinnofcarroll.com/offers.md)
- [OpenAPI agent contract](https://ai.motorinnofcarroll.com/openapi.json)
- [MCP endpoint](https://ai.motorinnofcarroll.com/mcp)
- [Search vehicles](https://ai.motorinnofcarroll.com/api/v1/vehicles)
- [Carroll service information](https://ai.motorinnofcarroll.com/api/v1/service-information)
- [Service scheduler handoff](https://ai.motorinnofcarroll.com/service-scheduler)
- [Parts information](https://ai.motorinnofcarroll.com/api/v1/parts-information)

The canonical DealerOn HTML controls customer-facing facts. Inventory is published only after matching DealerVault/Athena data to a current public DealerOn vehicle page.
Following the service link is not a confirmed appointment. A parts request is not a confirmed parts order. Only the authoritative provider may return those confirmed states.
